name: Carved Quran Court
summary: An oblique mosque courtyard rises from the two sculpted leaves of an open Quran.
why: The front dome and doorway share x45. The right facade meets the front along x60, and the square minaret overlaps the side wall. Both book leaves share the six-unit central fold at x56,y74â€“80 and join the building foundation.
risk: The view is deliberately oblique. At 24 px the book becomes a colored lower sweep and the side doorway reduces to a notch.
sub1: Two facades share a sculpted, continuous volume
sub2: The Quran leaves meet at one central fold
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque with real depth and Quran reading integrated into its foundation.
